methodology.summary: GPT-5.5 enriches a contributor-balanced maximum of 500 contributions; deterministic baselines cover the complete window and code calculates Output, Ownership, and the final ranking.
limitations: Public Git evidence cannot capture private planning, mentoring, incident response, reviews, or other invisible work.
Scores compare visible contributions within this repository and time window only.
Unknown file paths receive a conservative component importance of 4/10.
GPT enrichment is capped at 500 contributions; remaining records use auditable title/path heuristics.
